title: tephrosia cinerea
intro: Tephrosia cinerea, commonly known as White Horsefly, is a legume plant native to tropical Africa. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antimalarial activities. The therapeutic actions of Tephrosia cinerea include its potential to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
